changes.evidence: Cloak & Dagger season 2 (from episode 16 on, through episode 20): Andre is the secret leader of the trafficking ring he runs with Lia Dewan out of the support group and the Viking Motel, where girls are abducted, drained of hope and sold. The record's own step says he runs it, but he has no group. The screen gives the ring no name (the wiki calls it 'Viking Motel Sex Traffic Ring'), so this uses the dataset's existing name for it from the pr network circles (Andre and Lia are both in 'Andre's trafficking ring').

owner_calls.question: Before his first title, Andre played trumpet at Club Delight with his jazz band (told and shown in Cloak & Dagger season 2, episode 'Blue Note'). A band counts as a group under the owner's rules, but the screen never names it. Add it as a past group, and under what name?
options: Add a past stage with a descriptive name, e.g. 'Andre's jazz band' / 'The Club Delight band'
owner_calls.evidence: D'Spayre wiki: 'Deschaine regularly played his trumpet at a location called Club Delight with the rest of his band' (ref CD209); he stopped because of his migraines, before the rig explosion.
